# virtualbox Provider

VirtualBox Terraform provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    virtualbox = {
      source  = "bryanbelanger/virtualbox"
      version = "~> 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "virtualbox" {
  # Optional: path to VBoxManage (defaults to "VBoxManage" found in PATH).
  # vboxmanage_path = "/usr/local/bin/VBoxManage"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `vboxmanage_path` (String) Path to the VBoxManage executable. Defaults to 'VBoxManage' found in PATH.
